name: ctx-kit
description: Session lifecycle toolkit for Claude Code: state lives on disk, sessions are disposable. 6 skills (ctx-init / ctx-kickoff / ctx-handoff / ctx-takeover / ctx-status / ctx-checkup) + a PreCompact warning hook + a cache-audit script + a digest subagent. The hook only shows a notification before auto-compact; the script only reads local session logs. 会话生命周期工具包：状态在盘上，会话可抛弃。
